fact: UNDP's 2025 annual report states that in 2026 and beyond UNDP will focus on digitalising Burundi's criminal justice chain, expanding digital case-management tools and secure information-sharing among judicial actors, after training 200 judicial police officers between January 2024 and December 2025 with catalytic funding from its Global Programme.
title: 2025 Annual Report, UNDP's Global Programme for Strengthening the Rule of Law, Human Rights, Justice and Security for Sustainable Peace and Development (Phase IV): Burundi
